build.beforeDevCommand: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @ascii/web

security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob: asset: https://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; script-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Color image-to-ASCII converter with optional 3D parallax.
bundle.longDescription: ImageToASCII3D converts images into color ASCII art and can use depth maps to create exportable Three.js parallax assets.
